verdict.rationale: Factory's built-in agent, Droid, is the core of the product. The docs say you can delegate a task, review the diff and merge from the App or terminal. You can also hand scoped tasks to Custom Droids via /droids, assign Linear or Jira issues to Factory, or run multi-agent Missions, and Droid shows its proposed changes before applying them. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration; all evidence is vendor documentation.
